verdict.rationale: Ironclad's store-contracts product page claims secure storage and easy retrieval ('Store Contracts Securely, Find Them Easily'). The Records API lets users retrieve, update and create records, which supports a repository of executed contracts. However, the pack only offers page titles and API one-liners, and nothing explicitly documents automatic extraction of key terms or metadata. missing for 10: documented search capabilities, explicit AI extraction of key terms and metadata from executed contracts, in-depth repository documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can store executed contracts in a searchable repository with key terms and metadata extracted
